title: One-Step Equations: Addition & Subtraction

copy.studentInstructions: Solve each one-step equation for x using inverse addition or subtraction. Mark the value of x in the matching column.
copy.roomIntro: 50 one-step equations, always using x. M has simple whole-number equations with positive solutions. A introduces negative values; T adds signed constants and some equations with x on the right. H uses decimals and O uses fractions.
copy.callerSubtitle: Undo the addition or subtraction. Find the value of x.
copy.joinIntro: Enter your teacher’s room code to join.
copy.footer: Use the inverse operation. Solve for x.
copy.bankIntro: 10 equations per column. M: positive whole-number solutions 1–10. A: addition/subtraction with positive constants and both positive and negative solutions. T: adding/subtracting negative constants, with x sometimes on the right. H: signed decimals to hundredths. O: signed fractions with common denominators up to 12. Every equation has exactly one x with coefficient +1 and one added or subtracted constant. Answers are simplified values of x. Signed-in edits save to your private teacher library.
